messages:
Ellen: Quick heads-up: running a short 'migration bakeoff' today to validate v1->v2 docs changes end-to-end. Goal: confirm examples, redirects, and the small compatibility shim behave before we publish the deprecation notice. 20m sync.
Vik: I can run the eval harness + perf smoke. Planning to compare outputs from r-chat-2023-11 vs r-chat-2024-02 on our canonical prompt set.
Samir: I'll gate the SDK snippet swaps. I have a tiny compatibility shim in sdk-utils: `compat.invokeShim()` that maps old call shapes to `responses.create`. We should prefer full snippet swaps in docs, but keep shim tests for customers migrating slowly.
Ellen: Good. Priorities: 1) docs snippets replaced, 2) redirects validated, 3) shim smoke does not change public examples.
Rae: I'll handle redirects and the redirect-validator script. Reminder: avoid changing user-facing slugs; prefer redirect entries.
Samir: Example of shim usage (internal test only):
```js
// shim converts old v1 usage to v2 under the hood
const client = new RedwoodClient({shim: true})
await client.invoke({ model: 'r-chat', prompt: 'Hi' })
// shim uses responses.create and maps output to a .text-like shape
```
Ellen: Docs snippets to prefer (explicit v2):
```ts
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'r-chat-2024-02',
  input: 'Summarize the release notes'
})
// helper keeps examples terse
const text = docs.utils.extractText(res)
console.log(text)
```
Vik: Bakeoff steps I'll run:
- baseline: run eval harness on old model (r-chat-2023-11)
- candidate: run eval harness on new model (r-chat-2024-02)
- compare: diffs by metric (BLEU-ish proxy we use + token delta + latency)
- docs smoke: execute code snippets against sandbox endpoint to ensure shape stability
QA: I'll run snippet smoke (`npm run smoke:snippets`) against staging. Will check for `.text` top-level access and missing headers.
Intl: Mark any strings changed with `i18n:needs-review`. We'll queue translations for next run.
Legal: Please confirm deprecation notice wording once final. Keep timeline < 60 days and include rollback instructions.
Rae: Redirect validator output: one renamed slug triggered a conflict with a legacy redirect; I'll open a tiny PR to resolve.
docs-bot: PRs created: 7 (3 snippet swaps, 2 redirect updates, 1 shim-test, 1 helper). Labels applied: `docs/migration-bakeoff`, `needs-qa`.
Samir: Note: some examples previously relied on `res.generations[0].text`. New responses shape uses `res.output[...]` which can contain multiple blocks. I'll add a short migration tip in the playbook: prefer `extractText` helper or `output.flatMap(c=>c.text).join('\n')`.
Ellen: Add a short note for function/tool call cases: they appear in `res.output` as type `tool_call` and not in `output_text`. Link to the function-calling guide.
Vik: Quick sanity: candidate model had +3% better quality on our eval set but 12% higher token usage for one prompt family. Flagging for cost/quality tradeoff section in the migration playbook.
QA: Smoke results: 2 examples failed due to missing `Content-Type` header in curl snippets; opened PR to fix. Also one JS snippet still used `.text` directly; filed issue #327.
Samir: I'll patch SDK helper to ensure the shim only used in legacy mode and add tests verifying example outputs remain stable.
Rae: Redirects merged, validator green after tiny PR.
Intl: Noted 4 changed strings that require translation. Added `i18n:needs-review` tag to those PRs.
Legal: Reviewed deprecation draft; small wording tweak suggested (clarify SLA unaffected). Posted comments on PR #9044.
Ellen: Final checklist before publish: all snippet PRs merged, redirects merged, smoke green, bakeoff summary posted to /docs/news draft. Who can +1 release note?
Vik: +1 for release note (pending legal tweak).
Samir: +1 for snippets and shim tests.
QA: +1 after fixes merge.
docs-bot: Merges: 6. CI: passed. Pending: legal wording fix.
Ellen: Great work. Once legal merges wording, I'll publish the deprecation notice and close this bakeoff thread. If anyone finds stray `invoke` hits, paste file path here and I'll reassign. Thanks team! :rocket:
